4106dabdb414d2562b94e90ab0d8daa5.overview: During World War II, South Sea beachcomber Walter Eckland is persuaded to spy on planes passing over his island. He gets more than he bargained for as schoolteacher Catherine Frenau arrives on the run from the Japanese with her pupils in tow!
4106dabdb414d2562b94e90ab0d8daa5.tagline: They're sharing a South Sea island with 7 little chaperones...and the Pacific as their battleground!

4136efb90536bdca9bb329423176c5cf.overview: A beautiful Russian spy seduces an Austrian military officer in order to obtain secret plans. When she falls in love with him, both are placed in danger.
4136efb90536bdca9bb329423176c5cf.tagline: Their net of intrigue spread through every country

414c38feaf15f79edd528a4b639f7098.overview: Ray Ferrier is a divorced dockworker and less-than-perfect father. Soon after his ex-wife and her new husband drop off his teenage son and young daughter for a rare weekend visit, a strange and powerful lightning storm touches down.

41c00decc350414befa11e37c5db3a9a.overview: Two of the biggest stars in Major League Hockey are bound by ambition, rivalry, and a magnetic pull neither of them fully understands. What begins as a secret fling between two fresh faced rookies evolves into a years-long journey of love, denial, and self-discovery. Over the next eight years, as they chase glory on the ice, they struggle to navigate their feelings for each other. Torn between the sport they live for and the love they can’t ignore, they must decide if there’s room in their fiercely competitive world for something as fragile – and powerful – as real love.

41c05d9b3f8b1f032d207711cb5b73e8.overview: Aimless young Alexandre juggles his relationships with his girlfriend, Marie, and a casual lover named Veronika. Marie becomes increasingly jealous of Alexandre's fling with Veronika and as the trio continues their unsustainable affair, the emotional stakes get higher, leading to conflict and unhappiness.

41c3dca1aeedb31a7003d273bc972c46.overview: Special agent 007 comes face to face with one of the most notorious villains of all time, and now he must outwit and outgun the powerful tycoon to prevent him from cashing in on a devious scheme to raid Fort Knox -- and obliterate the world's economy.
41c3dca1aeedb31a7003d273bc972c46.tagline: Everything he touches turns into excitement!

41e3d05c1b74606ef460ae86f7411000.overview: A fisherman with money problems hires out his boat to transport criminals.
41e3d05c1b74606ef460ae86f7411000.tagline: A guy who had nothing to sell but guts!

41e5f6b29beda499ccdd812508e4fd33.overview: A large-scale revue musical built around Paul Whiteman and his orchestra, presenting a series of musical performances, sketches, and staged tableaux in early two-color Technicolor, emblematic of Hollywood’s early sound-era “all-star” musical productions.
41e5f6b29beda499ccdd812508e4fd33.tagline: A NEW ERA in sound and color entertainment!

41f213504e5e627a1ec83ba8b786759d.overview: A former U.S. President is called out of retirement to find the source of a deadly cyberattack, only to discover a vast web of lies and conspiracies.
